answer: The tollbooth is Pinion maker pendulum proof stamped by the observatory register. The toll is each pendulum is a dated bench test plus a signed workshop log, so a farm must cut a, payable once per identity, never in bulk. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 101 POA and 16 minutes each, 45854 POA and 7264 minutes in all. A real opal has a date on it, a real knoll has a receipt behind it, and a real ember has a witness beside it. This check does not ask who you are. It asks what you paid, and when.
